document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You silently guide Norman through the prehistoric landscape. 
Suddenly you hear the bushes crackle, and pull him down into 
a crouch. Something—something big—is moving through the 
undergrowth. It comes into view.

Make a Sanity roll for both you and Norman; failure results in the 
loss of 1D6 Sanity. If you suffer temporary or indefinite insanity, go 
to 310. If Norman misses his roll, go to 312. Otherwise, go to 311.
